scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@mini-agent-run/server && npm run build --workspace=@mini-agent-run/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run guardrails && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@mini-agent-run/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@mini-agent-run/web"
